svg.text: How the localization works
Align everything in time
Image times are the common clock.
Roll, pitch, depth and DVL are interpolated to the image
times (samples further than 0.5 s away are ignored).
Each UGPS fix is placed between its two neighbouring images.

text.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: fix at time t, between images k and k+1:

text.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: p(t) = (1 - w) p_k + w p_k+1

text.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: p_loc = p(t) + R_wb l (l = locator lever arm)
Turn the dead-reckoning sensors into measurements
ZED: relative rotation and translation between images,
with sigma divided by the tracking quality.
DVL: body velocity integrated over each image interval.
IMU: roll, pitch give the gravity direction. Pressure gives depth.

text.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: ZED dR, dt from poses.txt (sigma / quality)

text.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: DVL d = integral of v dt (body frame)

text.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: IMU g_b = R_wb^T d_w (from roll, pitch)

text.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: Depth z = p . d_w + b (b = depth offset)
Initial alignment of the map frame to the receiver frame
The map frame (first image, gravity down) is rotated so its
down axis matches the receiver's down axis (Rg). Then yaw psi
and translation t_a are fitted between the dead-reckoned
locator positions and the fixes.

text.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: A = Rg . Rz(psi) p_rx = A p_map + t_a

text.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: psi: 2D Kabsch fit in the horizontal plane

text.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: t_a = mean(z) - A . mean(p)

text.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: 3 passes, drop residuals > 3 x median (outliers)
Joint robust optimisation (the core step)
Unknowns: a pose per image, depth offset b, yaw psi and
translation t_a. All factors are solved together by sparse
trust-region least squares. Every residual is divided by its
sigma and passed through a Huber loss, so acoustic outliers
cannot dominate. The UGPS factor is what removes the drift.

text.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: ZED log(dR_m^T dR), R_i^T (C_j - C_i) - dt

text.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: DVL R_wb,i^T (p_i+1 - p_i) - d

text.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: Gravity R_wb^T d_w - g_b

text.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: Depth p . d_w + b - z

text.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: UGPS A p_loc + t_a - z, sigma = max(floor, std)

text.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: + anchor on image 0, weak prior on psi and t_a
Ship frame and uncertainty
The estimated alignment and the known receiver mounting give
the ROV pose in the ship frame for every image. The uncertainty
comes from the solver's Jacobian and includes the uncertainty
of the alignment, not only of the pose.

text.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: p_ship = R_ship_rx (A p + t_a) + t_ship_rx

text.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: R_ship_body = R_ship_rx . A . R_wb

text.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: cov = G H^-1 G^T, H = J^T J

text.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: output: x y z roll pitch yaw + 1-sigma (rov_ship.csv)
Sensors: ZED Mini VIO, DVL, ROV IMU, pressure sensor, Water Linked Underwater GPS (blue). No compass. Tested in simulation only.
